description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2046/16 adding Sub Paragraph on sale of Yachts etc.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains detailed modifications to tariff schedules and HS code classifications, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
